rejects.event: Porto Alegre was founded by Manuel Jorge Gomes de Sepúlveda.
rejects.quote: Porto Alegre was founded in 1769 by Manuel Jorge Gomes de Sepúlveda, who used the pseudonym José Marcelino de Figueiredo to hide his identity; the official date, though, is 1772 with the act signed by immigrants from the Azores, Portugal.
rejects.why: The source quote states the official date of foundation is 1772, contradicting the year 1769 in the claim.
